en: The real whuppin' starts now.
This has already gone on long enough.
I said, I ain't through with ya yet!
Give it a rest already.

I don't have any more time
to waste on this!
Wh-Whaddya mean?

If you want a fight,
you'll have to find someone else.
Not everyone's as free as you.
Welcome back.
Thanks. Looks like I just made it.
Here, Kiryu-san.
Hi there. Sorry for the wait.
You can really throw 'em back...
The man who raised me...
...was once a member of the yakuza.
I know he looks scary to most people...

...but he always treated me
with respect and kindness.

Even though he was a bit unconventional,
I could always rely on him.

I... I think of him like a father.
And I love him very much.

I don't want to keep lying to
everyone like this though.
Not to my fans... and not to myself.
My dream has always been to be a star.
But there's something I want even more.

I want to live a happy life with
the people I hold closest.
That's why I can't continue singing.

I'm going to be with Kazuma Kiryu.
He is my family.

I have to get back...
Everyone is waiting for me...
Uncle Kaz? Uncle Kaz!
Haruka?
Hold on, Uncle Kaz!
A dream... Am I dreaming?

You're not.
I'm really here, with you.
I just spoke to the doctor.

Kiryu-san's gonna be okay.
He'll be on his way home in a few weeks.
I see. Thank you for checking.

By the way, you were real smooth up
on stage. It's been all over the news.

But, I've gotta warn you, this may not
turn out the way you're hoping it will.

First you have a yakuza-raised idol
announcing her retirement mid-concert.

Meanwhile, the Tojo Clan and the Omi Alliance
are tearing at each other's throats in the street.

If the news is anything to go by, going back to
the simple life with Kiryu-san could be rough.
Might be a while before things quiet down.
I know.
Well, not like it's any of my business anyway.
I have faith in you two.
There's nothing you guys couldn't do.

Right. Thank you for all
the help, Akiyama-san.

That reminds me, will your business
be okay without you?

With a secretary like mine on the case?
Oh, it'll be more than okay.

She's capable of running the show on her
own for a bit. Don't sweat it.
What about you, Haruka-chan?
You two gonna head back to Morning Glory?
Yeah, I think so.

That orphanage is where we call home,
and those kids are practically family.

I see. Guess Kamurocho'll be
getting a bit lonelier then.

What's up, copper? Slow your roll.
You're gonna spook the patients.
He's here for me.

They're arrestin' me again.
I still got time to serve.

Glad your head's in the right place.
Maybe we'll even be lenient.
Taiga Saejima. Please come peacefully.
Wasn't plannin' on fightin' ya.

Screw this noise. Why's it always gotta
go down like this with you, bro?
It's all good.
The rest is up to you, bro.

While you guys're busy cleanin' up
the Tojo Clan's whole mess...

...I'm gonna be bored outta
my mind in a prison cell.
One more thing.
This is Kazuma Kiryu's room, yes?
Eh? What's it matter?

I'm with the police.
Remain calm, please.
Kazuma Kiryu...

Under suspicion of assault and
destruction of private property...
...is under arrest.
No prob.
Kiryu-san should be healed up soon enough.
It's good to see you.
How are things?
Things haven't changed much, actually.

Morning Glory's just like you left it.
Everyone's doing really well.
That's great.
I'm glad to hear it.

The others really wanted to see you too,
but it would've cost a fortune to get them all here.

Everyone down in Okinawa is treating us
well though. You don't need to worry about us.
And the media?
There have been a few reporters, but...
...I've handled them.
I'm sorry, Haruka.
There's not much I can do for you now.

I should be out in three years
if I can make parole, though.
Three years... That's a long time.

I'm going to make sure you're never
ashamed to call me family again.
That's what these three years are for.

Once I became an idol, it really hurt
having to keep my distance from you.
I'm not saying I regret my decision.
It's actually the opposite.

All that time apart helped me realize
how close we really are, Uncle Kaz.

So when I told the world how I felt
about you up on that stage...
...I meant it.

Until then, I had always taken
our time together for granted.
I mean, I was just a kid.

That stuff had never really
crossed my mind before.

But that's why even if we're not
together... I'll keep my chin up.

No matter how far apart we are,
we're still family. I know that in my heart.
That's what I came to tell you today.

It would be too embarrassing to say
it once we're living together again...
I get that.
Hey, dinner's ready.
Get all this stuff off the table!

Koji, you can't just leave your
manga lying around like this.

Izumi, can you get some
water for everyone?

Hey Shiro, tablet away when
you're at the dinner table.

Just give me a second.
I'm almost finished checking my stocks.

You're not really playing
the market on that thing, are you?

Like we have the cash for that.
It's just a simulation.
Mitsuo still isn't home from practice.
He's going all out, huh?

Baseball's his life.
Wonder if he'll get that scholarship.
I'm back.
We're home!
Haruka-chan, we have enough for seconds?
There's more rice, yeah.
I'm good for today.

I promised Oshiro I'd train with
him some more after dinner.

Uncle Kaz is gonna be so surprised
when he gets out of jail.

Who'd have guessed Mitsuo would
end up a pro baseball player?

Don't jinx him, you dummy.
He's still just in middle school.

But if he's competing for
a scholarship...
Mitsuo must have worked really hard.

Koji was the one showing him the ropes,
but now he's just getting shown up.
Shut up!

Nothing's decided yet though.
There are other candidates too.

Apparently they look into all sorts of stuff.
Your grades, your living situation...
Wait, living situation...?
Ain't it bad if you're here then?
But seriously...

It'll be fine. Everyone knows I'm one
of the kids from Morning Glory.
And they approached me anyway.

If the scholarship doesn't work out,
it just means I wasn't good enough.
Uncle Kaz... I...
What am I supposed to do?
I knew it.
(Yakuza girl Haruka spotted at Morning Glory)

(It's scary how Haruka Sawamura
just waltzed back to Okinawa.)
(Morning Glory's a yakuza safe house!)
I never should have come back here...
I'm so sorry, everyone.
So you're really leaving, Haruka-chan.
It's because of this, isn't it?
So you saw it too, Ayako.

Are you worried about
Mitsuo's scholarship?
It's not just about him.

Any one of you could end up with
big chances like that in the future.
If you lost them because of me...
...I'd never forgive myself.
I never realized how harsh life can be.
Uncle Kaz did, though.
That's why he's in jail now.

What are you gonna do once you leave?
Where are you gonna go?
I want to be closer to Uncle Kaz.

What do you mean? You know it's gonna
be years until he gets out, right?

(Exclusive! Where is the Yakuza Idol
Haruka Sawamura Six Months Later!?)

(Ex-Tojo Clan Yakuza, K-san, Has Deep
Ties to Okinawan Orphanage)
Does he know you're leaving Morning Glory?
No. I came to this decision all on my own.

I'll write him a letter to say
you're coming, then.
Don't.

I'll explain everything to him
once we're together.

Several fires were reported all around
Little Asia at roughly the same time.
Do you think it's arson?

Fire department better be on the way.
How's the evac going?

Well, sir!
It's spreading quickly though...
What a mess...
Little Asia's gonna burn to cinders.

What do you think?
Quite a view, isn't it?

These flames should serve as
proof of our dedication to the cause.

Gentlemen, lasting prosperity is
now within arm's reach.
Shall we toast to that?
U-Uncle Kaz?
Izumi?
You're taller than I remember.

Uncle Kaz! Wait, you're really here!?
How'd you get back so soon!?
Did I surprise you?

Hey, Uncle Kaz is back!
He's back, everyone!
Uncle Kaz!
Taichi!

You jerk! I thought you were
never gonna come home.
Why'd you make us wait so long!?
I'm sorry, Taichi.
You guys have gotten really big.
How many years has it been?
All of you look so grown up.

Hey, where's Haruka-chan?
You came together, right?

Oh yeah!
She'll be here soon, right?
No, she's not with me.
Is Haruka not around?

What do you mean, Uncle Kaz?
She said she'd be with you.
Yeah, that's what she said.
Ain't that right, Ayako-chan?
I'm sorry.
I'm so sorry!

Haruka-chan left Morning Glory just
about three years ago now.

We got calls from her at first,
but those stopped in the past year or so.

It all felt so strange. She's not
the kind of person to just disappear.
She said she was living near you, though.

Why don't we just call her already!?
Come on!

We don't have any way to reach her.
All her calls have been from pay phones.

She apparently canceled her cell contract
right after she left Morning Glory.
Why didn't she tell us any of this herself?

You and her always treat us like
we're just a bunch of little kids!
I'm sorry. I just...
I didn't want you to worry.

Besides, I really thought there was
a chance she'd come back with Uncle Kaz.

But still! Why'd Haruka-chan have to
leave us here in the first place?
Things were good, weren't they?

Does Haruka-chan...
not like us anymore?

That's not it. She doesn't want to
hold us back. That's what she told me.

Huh? Hold us back?
What's that supposed to mean?

Right around when Mitsuo was up for that
baseball scholarship from his school...
...this article got published.

I think Haruka-chan hated the idea of
her actions turning people against us.

Plus, back then, we didn't know how
Mitsuo's career would play out yet.
What? Are you trying to pin this on me!?
No, that's not what she meant.

It's not your fault, Mitsuo.
And it's not Haruka's either.
The blame... is all on me.
Uncle Kaz...

I'm going to find Haruka.
I swear.
I'll bring her back.

How do I always end up
back in this damn city?

I appreciate the courage
you've shown in coming here.

However, there will be no tolerance
for Tojo arrogance here in Little Asia.

You'll have to take this at face value,
but we aren't looking for violence today.

All we want is for your boss to
hear what we have to say.
We risked our lives to even get here.

If you're really here to talk, what are you
doing with that gun in your pocket?

You'd have us stroll into triad turf
without some form of self-defense?
Let's just keep this civil.

There is little need for conversation
when it's clear what the Tojo Clan wants.

You'd like us to confine ourselves to
this tiny box that is Little Asia, yes?

In exchange, we're prepared to officially
recognize Little Asia as your territory.
Just make sure your boss understands...

If any triads take so much as a step
outside of Little Asia's borders...
...We will show them no mercy.

So, what? Are you saying you've
been lenient prior to today?
Yes, very perceptive.

My boss has already given me
his answer to your ultimatum.

Though I'm worried you won't understand.
My Japanese isn't so great, after all.

You speak better than most of
the younger members of our clan.
Do I really?

Even so, I'd rather you convey our
message to your boss in your own words.

He'll want to know everything
that's about to happen.
Hey, what do you think you're doing!?

If you were going to shoot,
you should've done it.
Shit!
This is the Saio Triad's answer.
...Akiyama?

Wait, what the?
Kiryu-san!?
It's been a while.
Er... Well...

Come on in.
Take a load off.

As you can probably tell,
that's about all I can offer.
I've been looking for you.
Rumor has it you closed down Sky Finance.
Yeah, well...

Couldn't tell you why, but the triads
kinda want my head on a stick.
Figured I'd take a little break.
Not like I'll stay down here forever, though.
I've heard all about that.

Sounds like Kamurocho's having
some rough times these days.

Yeah. I even had to send my secretary
back to her family in the countryside.

It got too dangerous to risk keeping her
in the middle of this mess.
Makes sense.

That said, you're looking better
than I was expecting.

Same to you, Kiryu-san. Glad to see
you're finally back on the street.
But, what are you doing in Kamurocho?
I came to see you.
As for why...

...I thought you might have some
idea of where Haruka is.
Haruka-chan?
You mean she didn't go back to Morning Glory?
Ah! Man, it feels good to get some sun.
The air's so fresh, too.
Sorry about that, Akiyama.
I led them right to you.

Don't worry about it. I was getting
bored of sleeping the days away.
